Voice apps speak different languages. Your browser uses Web R T C. Your phone system uses S I P. And your A I assistant needs to reach a human.
Bridgefu connects those worlds. It's a Rust media gateway built on r-voip. Two call legs. One bridge for bidirectional audio, keypad tones, and explicitly allowed context.
Bridgefu handles protocol boundaries and converts codecs when needed, so each side can keep its own stack.
One reference workflow connects a Vapi S I P transfer to Amazon Connect, carrying a correlation I D for an agent screen pop.
